sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga for the State and perused the records.
2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to
quash charge-sheet no.11 of 2018 dated 19.02.2018 as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 1968 of
2018 (State Vs. Ravi and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 131 of 2017, under Sections 498A,
323, 504, 506 Ipc and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Gautam Budh Nagar,
pending in the court of Civil Judge (S.D.), F.T.C., Gautam Budh Nagar.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that opposite party no.2 is the wife of the
applicant and on account of matrimonial discord, present criminal case has been instituted against
the applicant by opposite party no.2, however subsequently, with the intervention of respected
Ravi vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 August, 2023

1

members of both the families, applicant and opposite party no.2 have amicably and genuinely
settled all their disputes and differences and now they do not have any grievance against each other.

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has next drawn the attention of this Court to a compromise
deed dated 13.02.2023, drawn between the parties, a copy of which has been annexed as Annexure-5
to his application.
5.

This Court vide its order dated 27.04.2023 had directed the parties to appear before the court below and file a copy of the said compromise deed, which shall be verified by the court below and after verification of the compromise, a report be submitted to this Court.

6. Pursuant to the said order dated 27.04.2023, the parties appeared before the court below and in their presence, after due verification of the contents of the compromise made between the parties,
an order dated 08.05.2023 has been passed by the court below verifying the said compromise.

7. Learned counsel for the applicant has next submitted that in view of the said compromise as well as report of the court below and in order to maintain harmonious and cordial relations between the parties, entire proceedings against the applicants be quashed.
8.Learned AGA could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

9. This Court is not unmindful of the judgements of the Apex Court in the cases of:-
(1). B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another (2003) 4 SCC 675.
(2).
